title: Record the live dev ruleset and CI in the ward-cli profile
description: OPAG-655 AC5 asks for the gated ref's required checks recorded in the repository profile as measured from the live ruleset. Ruleset 24097150 was created by the user on 2026-09-28 from the WCLI-17 payload.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CLAUDE.md profile records the gated ref, ruleset id, required contexts and integration exactly as `gh api repos/opum-ai/ward-cli/rules/branches/dev` returns them, with the measurement date
